name: empty-plan
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Walking the questions: the active questions are the plan variables plus every variable of every active section. A plan with neither has none

name: reading-order
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Order: plan variables first, then each active section's questions in document order. ordering.md: timing, then after, then id. Declaration order inside a section is the order of the variables list

name: inactive-sections
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a switched-off section is not active and its questions are not asked. conditions.md: includeIf false puts the section out. A section clause tests the switch only. No question is listed for the switch

name: audience-split
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: a variable has an audience, onboarder by default, and either scope can have either. Every active question is listed whoever answers it, in one order. A named audience lists its own questions, and its blockers are its own required questions with no answer. docs/reference/section-template-schema/variables.md, Audience

name: kinds-and-defaults
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/variables.md, Fields: type is string by default, audience is onboarder by default. docs/reference/domain-model.md, Question: type and audience are not optional

name: answers-as-stored
source: docs/reference/domain-model.md, Question: answer is the stored answer, if any. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: the Text deferred differs from the Deferred kind

name: defaults-are-suggestions
source: docs/decisions/0045-defaults-are-suggestions.md: a default is a suggestion, never an answer. A question with a default and no answer is unanswered, and a required one blocks

name: blockers
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Where the behavior lives: Blockers lists active required questions with no answer, for an audience. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: a required question is satisfied by a settled or a deferred answer, unanswered blocks. A false flag is settled

name: ask-if-tests
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md, Answer tests and Rules: every test except isSettled is false for a deferred or unanswered question, a default is not an answer, a false flag is settled, an empty all always holds. The finder evaluates askIf through the condition evaluator

name: ask-if-scope
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md, Syntax: a bare name is a question in the same section, plan.<name> is a plan variable. contracts/condition/evaluator/contract.md, Finding the answer: a bare name never falls back

name: ask-if-section-clause
source: docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a question's askIf may test whether a section is on. The clause tests the switch only. A section with no enabled field is on. The switches are those of every section of the plan

name: ask-if-inactive-answers
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md, Rules: a settled answer is one for a question that is active and has a stored answer. docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Conditions: a question whose condition is false keeps its answer, is not asked

name: order-condition-names-later-section
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/ordering.md, Question order in the walkthrough: if a condition refers to a later section, the finder moves the dependent question to just after the question it needs

name: order-condition-names-later-question
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Order: a question is never asked before the questions its condition names. ordering.md, Question order in the walkthrough

name: order-ignores-questions-not-asked
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Order: a question is never asked before the questions its condition names. A question that is not asked is not a constraint. Decision to know in contract.md

name: ask-if-cycle
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/ordering.md, Question order in the walkthrough: a cycle is reported as a problem and not resolved. The plan validator reports it. Decision to know in contract.md

name: groups
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Groups: questions with the same name, type, options, and multiple form a group. docs/reference/domain-model.md, Question: group is the key shared by those questions

name: suggestions-defaults
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: the distinct declared defaults in its group. Decision to know in contract.md for questions that are not active

name: suggestions-given
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: the answers already given for that name in any scope, the plan's and every section's, inactive ones included

name: suggestions-default-and-given
source: docs/reference/domain-model.md, Suggestion: source is default or given. Decision to know in contract.md for a value that is both

name: suggestions-valid-values
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: for a boolean or choice only valid values are offered. contract.md, Rules, for the kind each type holds

name: suggestions-pattern
source: docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Suggestions: for a string with a pattern, a candidate that does not match is dropped. variables.md: pattern is RE2 syntax

name: suggestions-settled-only
source: docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: unanswered and deferred are not settled. docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, Entry rules: deferred is offered as its own entry, not as a suggestion

name: suggestions-lists
source: docs/reference/section-template-schema/variables.md, Types and Directory: a command holds a list, a contact with multiple holds a list of ids, a contact holds one id, and same-name contact variables group and offer an earlier entry. contracts/plan/testdata/directory.plan.json for the shape of the directory

name: acme
source: docs/reference/examples/acme, as contracts/plan/testdata/acme.plan.json, with a directory that holds the two contacts that stuck-general names. Expected questions written by hand from the plan: the software discipline leaves out review-design-system, account_name is an onboardee question and is asked in the full list, tracker_grantor is deferred

name: audience-ask-if
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: a question is active by its own condition, whoever answers it, so an onboarder question may depend on an onboardee answer, and the other way round. Conditions are unchanged: a condition on an unanswered question is false. docs/decisions/0010-plan-editor.md, order: a question comes after the question it needs. conditions.md: a settled answer is one for a question that is active

name: audience-blockers
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: blockers are per audience, a required onboardee question does not block the onboarder, and an answer already in the file is respected. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: settled or deferred satisfies a required question. 0050: an off or left-out section is not asked

name: audience-section-choice
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Context and Rules: a plan variable may have audience onboardee and its answer chooses sections through includeIf, and the evaluator needs no change. conditions.md: includeIf reads the stored plan answers

name: audience-unanswered-choice
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: a condition on an unanswered question is false, so sections that depend on an onboardee answer stay out until the answer exists, and a required onboardee question does not block the onboarder

name: audience-suggestions
source: docs/decisions/0045-defaults-are-suggestions.md: the defaults of the questions in the group and the answers already given for the name, in any scope. docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md: scope and audience are separate, and the finder lists questions by audience only. Written by hand from the plan

name: examples
source: The example field change (model.Variable.Example and model.Question.Example): a variable has an optional example, one illustration of a good answer, empty when absent, and its question carries it. Nothing fills it in or accepts it as an answer or a default. The group key, activity, order, suggestions and blockers do not use it. Written by hand from the plan

name: subsection-gate-open
source: A sub-section's includeIf on its parent's answer holds: its questions come directly after the parent's, and its required question blocks. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: active by its own includeIf, which may name ancestors' questions; Order: its questions are asked after its parent's. docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md for the blocker rule

name: subsection-gate-closed
source: The same plan with the gate answered no: the sub-section's questions are not returned and its stored answer is not shown, and nothing blocks. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: active only if its own includeIf holds. 0070 Its answers stay its own

name: subsection-gate-unanswered
source: The same plan with the gate unanswered: the sub-section is out, and only the parent's required question blocks. conditions.md: a test on an unanswered question is false. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision

name: subsection-gate-hidden-parent-answer
source: The parent's gate question is hidden by its own askIf but has a stored answer. The sub-section is in, because the selector reads stored answers, while a question of the sub-section whose askIf names the hidden question reads it as unanswered. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md says a sub-section's includeIf names its ancestors' questions; conditions.md says a settled answer is one for an active question, which is the finder's rule for askIf (decision 01)

name: subsection-grandchild-open
source: A parent, a child and two grandchildren, one gated by the child's answer and one by the grandparent's. Questions come depth first, with siblings by id. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: includeIf may name questions of its ancestors, with a root's and a parent's; Order

name: subsection-grandchild-middle-out
source: The middle section's gate fails while both grandchildren have stored answers that would pass their own gates: nothing below the middle section is returned. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: a sub-section is active only if its parent is active, and its own parent in turn

name: subsection-grandchild-own-gates-closed
source: The middle section is on and each grandchild's own gate fails: the middle section's questions are returned and no grandchild's. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: a sub-section is then active by its own includeIf

name: subsection-order
source: Sub-sections, a grandchild, an earlier root and a later root, with the sections listed out of order in the plan: each sub-section's questions follow its parent's and its earlier siblings' subtrees, siblings follow after then id, and roots keep their order. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: directly after its parent and its earlier siblings, in the order the selector gives. ordering.md: timing, then after, then id

name: subsection-order-timing
source: A sub-section whose own timing is earlier than its root's stays after its root, and one whose timing is later does not let the next root move ahead of it. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Order: directly after its parent. ordering.md: timing, then after, then id

name: subsection-parent-off
source: Sub-sections of a switched-off section, down to a grandchild whose own switch is on, are not returned and do not block, and their stored answers stay in the plan. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: switches cascade. 0050: a switched-off section is not active

name: subsection-own-gates
source: A sub-section is out when its own switch is off or its own includeIf fails, and in when both pass, while its parent is on. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: a sub-section can be turned off alone, and is active by its own includeIf and switch

name: subsection-bad-parent
source: A parent that is not a section, a cycle, a section that names itself, and sections below them give no question, while a valid sub-section is returned. Plans the validators reject: the finder reads them as written and does not hang. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Consequences: the plan validator checks that the parent exists and that there is no cycle, so the finder only reads what the selector returns

name: subsection-switch-clause
source: A section clause tests the named section's own switch: a child whose parent is off still has its own switch on, and a section clause on a switched-off parent holds for off. The finder builds Switches from every section's own enabled field. docs/decisions/0070-sub-sections.md, Decision: switches cascade for activity; docs/decisions/0050-section-switch.md: a condition tests the switch the section holds

name: directory-choices
source: docs/decisions/0080-directory.md, Questions pick from the directory: the walkthrough offers the directory's entries to pick from, and the team question's options are the directory's teams. contracts/plan/testdata/directory.plan.json for the directory. The order is the directory's order, a choice holds the id and the name. A choice question and a string with options keep their own shape

name: directory-empty
source: docs/decisions/0080-directory.md, Integrity: an answer that names an id that is not in the directory counts as unanswered. Decisions of the directory wave: a plan with no directory has no entries to offer, so every id is unknown and a required question blocks

name: directory-contacts-only
source: docs/decisions/0080-directory.md, Questions pick from the directory: each of the three types is offered its own list. A directory with contacts only offers none for a role or a team, and a contact id is not a role id

name: directory-unknown-answers
source: docs/decisions/0080-directory.md, Integrity: an answer that names an id that is not in the directory counts as unanswered, so a required question blocks until it is filled. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: a deferred answer satisfies a required question. Decisions of the directory wave: ids are lowercase slugs, compared as written, and each type has its own list

name: directory-multiple
source: docs/decisions/0080-directory.md, Questions pick from the directory: a multiple contact or role question holds an ordered list. Decisions to know 25: it is answered when at least one id of the list is in the directory. docs/decisions/0035-settled-and-deferred-answers.md: a list with no settled item is unanswered

name: directory-ask-if
source: docs/decisions/0080-directory.md, Integrity: an answer that names an unknown id counts as unanswered. docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md: every test except isSettled is false for an unanswered question, and an askIf reads the answers of active questions. Decisions to know 26: a condition reads an unknown id as unanswered. contracts/condition/evaluator/contract.md: only isSettled applies to a list

name: directory-audience
source: docs/decisions/0055-variable-audience.md, Rules: an audience only chooses what is returned and each audience has its own blockers, and a condition reads an answer whoever answers it. docs/decisions/0080-directory.md, Integrity: an unknown id counts as unanswered. Directory questions follow the same rules as any other question

name: directory-suggestions
source: docs/decisions/0045-defaults-are-suggestions.md: a choice offers only valid values. docs/decisions/0080-directory.md: the entries of the directory are the valid values of a directory question. Decisions to know 28: a default or a given answer is offered only when every id in it is in the directory for the question's type, and given answers are those stored for the question's name in any scope
